newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CO-OP BANKS REPAY FIM 45 MLN STATE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CO-OP BANKS REPAY FIM 45 MLN STATE CAPITAL.

text.p: Fourteen cooperative banks on Friday repaid 45.2 million markka of state capital certificates from the Government Guarantee Fund, the cooperative banking group said in a statement.
"A total of 14 co-operative banks have on Friday repaid 45.2 million markka of the capital injection granted from the Government Guarantee Fund in 1993," it said on Friday.
The group of cooperative banks still had 456.7 million markka in state capital certificates divided between 20 banks, it said adding some 198 million had been repaid last year.
Fifty-four of the 300 cooperative banks received state capital certificates worth a total of 700 million markka in 1993, it said.
